tags.name: SS Stavronikita
tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-07-14 against Wikipedia-corroborating sources (adrex.com, caribdiveguide.com) and Caribbean Beat: length (365ft/111-112m), fire date (26 Aug 1976), sinking (Nov 1978), mast depth (6m) all reconfirmed across 3+ sources. Days adrift reported as 3 (Caribbean Beat) vs 4 (Scubaverse, Divernet) - description updated to note both figures rather than picking one.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: scuttling story cross-checked against carlislebaybarbados.org and barbadossnorkelingtours.org, both independently give the same 'crew grew fond of Barbadian rum/island life and refused to return to post-war Europe' account - added to description as a sourced local account (not treated as certain historical fact). Depth, date (1919), and marine life reconfirmed.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: ferro-cement construction, January 1986 sinking, and 12-13m depth reconfirmed via carlislebaybarbados.org and barbadossnorkelingtours.org. 45-foot length is a new corroborated detail added to description. No corrections needed.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: sinking year (1985) and general location (Almond Beach Village, St Peter) reconfirmed via caribbean-beat.com. However, cross-checking length and depth surfaced real source conflicts: length is given as 160ft (caribbean-beat.com), 165ft (divehightide.com), and 180ft (numa.net); depth is given as 9-15m (existing curated figure) vs 55-60ft/16.8-18m (divehightide.com, divebarbadosblue.com) vs 25-60ft (numa.net). Description updated to state these as a range with sources noted rather than a single figure.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: Dutch-built inter-island freighter, sister ship of Pamir, sunk near Asta Hotel reconfirmed. Exact sinking date '2 July 1985' is sourced to divehightide.com (which gives 'July 2, 1985'); caribbean-beat.com only confirms 'July 1985'. Depth has a real source conflict: 45ft/55ft (caribbean-beat.com/other sources) vs 70ft (numa.net) - description updated to present as a range citing sources rather than a single number.
Re-audited 2026-07-14: divehightide.com and scubadivingearth.com descriptions reconfirmed, no factual changes needed.
Re-audited 2026-07-14: divehightide.com and divebarbadosblue.com descriptions reconfirmed, no factual changes needed.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: dome-shaped reef, 8ft brown coral tree forests, and depth range reconfirmed via divehightide.com and barbados.org. No factual changes needed.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: depth range (60-145ft/18-44m) and 'closest thing to a coral wall' characterization reconfirmed via divehightide.com and barbados.org (135-145ft seabed depth). Site correctly kept as reef (not wall) since it is a bank/rise rather than a sheer drop-off, consistent with source descriptions. No factual changes needed.

Re-audited 2026-07-14: searched further (site:tripadvisor, coconut-court.com, general Christ Church dive site searches) but could not find a third independent, site-specific source for this specific shallow shore reef distinct from the nearby boat-accessible 'Carlenes Reef' (80-100ft, a different, deeper site off the same hotel strip per coconut-court.com/thescubaplace.co.uk). Only divebarbadosblue.com and barbados.org remain as sources. Per deep-QA policy this does not meet the 3-source bar; validated left as-is per instructions but flagged as unresolved/insufficient sourcing.
